question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Indebted
solution:
The correct answer is “**Thankful**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• "**Indebted**" refers to feeling as if one owes something to someone, often as a result of their help or support. (आभारी)

 
 
• **Example**- I am forever indebted to you for your kindness and support.
 
 
 
• "**Thankful**" means feeling or expressing gratitude, which is quite similar in meaning to "indebted". (आभारी)
 
 
• **Example**- I am forever thankful for your kindness and support.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word that is similar in meaning to the given word is 'Thankful’.

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 4**’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• "**Careless**" refers to not giving enough attention or thought to avoid harm or errors. (लापरवाह)
 
• "**Doubtful**" implies uncertainty or lack of conviction. (संदिग्ध)
 
• "**Envious**" means feeling a desire to have what someone else possesses. (ईर्ष्या भरा)
